svg.title: Held-out synthetic segmentation comparison
svg.desc: One predeclared test case from twelve, shown with equal physical scaling, 0.8 mm column spacing and 1.2 mm row spacing. A fixed intensity threshold is compared with an actually trained ten-parameter shared 3 by 3 convolution plus sigmoid. Complete images are split before training. Grayscale is 0 to 1; mask white means foreground. This is not U-Net and uses no patient data.
